mapper.sql: DETAILUUID,REPORTUUID,PROPERTYCODE, REPORTTYPE,GROUPTYPE, CNY,USD_TO_CNY, EUR_TO_CNY,GBP_TO_CNY, JPY_TO_CNY,OTH_TO_CNY, PRODCOUNTS, TOTAL
mapper.insert: insert into PBC_REPORT_PROD_DAT (DETAILUUID,REPORTUUID,PROPERTYCODE, REPORTTYPE,GROUPTYPE, CNY, USD_TO_CNY, EUR_TO_CNY, GBP_TO_CNY,JPY_TO_CNY, OTH_TO_CNY, PRODCOUNTS,TOTAL) values (#{detailuuid,jdbcType=CHAR},#{reportuuid,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{propertyCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{reporttype,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{grouptype,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{cny,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{usdToCny,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{eurToCny,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{gbpToCny,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{jpyToCny,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{othToCny,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{prodcounts,jdbcType=DECIMAL},#{total,jdbcType=DECIMAL})
mapper.select: select ppd.*, prp.CNY as cnyPrd, prp.USD_TO_CNY as usdToCnyPrd, prp.EUR_TO_CNY as eurToCnyPrd, prp.GBP_TO_CNY as gbpToCnyPrd, prp.JPY_TO_CNY as jpyToCnyPrd, prp.OTH_TO_CNY as othToCnyPrd, prp.PRODCOUNTS as prodcountsPrd, prp.TOTAL as totalPrd from PBC_REPORT_PROD_DAT ppd left join PBC_REPORT_PROD prp on ppd.REPORTUUID=prp.REPORTUUID and ppd.REPORTTYPE=prp.REPORTTYPE and ppd.propertyCode=prp.propertyCode where ppd.REPORTUUID = #{reportuuid,jdbcType=CHAR} and ppd.REPORTTYPE=#{reporttype,jdbcType=CHAR}

select prp.* from PBC_REPORT_PROD_DAT prp left join PBC_SEND_ZIP_DAT_FILE psz on psz.REPORTUUID=prp.REPORTUUID and psz.DAT_ZIP_DAT_TYPE =prp.REPORTTYPE where psz.DAT_ZIP_CODE=#{datZipCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and psz.DAT_ZIP_DAT_TYPE = #{datZipDatType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and prp.PROPERTYCODE is not null and (prp.CNY <> 0 or prp.USD_TO_CNY <> 0 or prp.EUR_TO_CNY <> 0 or prp.GBP_TO_CNY <> 0 or prp.JPY_TO_CNY <> 0 or prp.OTH_TO_CNY <> 0 or prp.PRODCOUNTS <> 0 or prp.TOTAL<> 0)
